requirement: The system shall provide personalized research internship project discovery, including recommendation, project detail viewing, rule-based search, and project favorites.
The system shall support the lifecycle of publishing, managing, applying to, and mutually evaluating research internship projects, including mentor-side applicant chat.

The system shall support user registration and login with university-email verification, enterprise certification with enterprise-email verification, and administrator login without an administrator self-registration entry; enterprise certification shall gate internship referral post publication permission.

The system shall support user personal information completion, student resume upload and permission-controlled viewing, mentor search and favorites, and authorized information display during two-way selection.

The system shall support community post display, publication, modification, deletion, comments, favorites, and popularity sorting, and shall distinguish ordinary posts from internship referral posts so that only enterprise-certified students can publish referral posts.

The system shall generate reminders for project and user-interaction events through in-site notifications, email push, or equivalent mechanisms, and maintain mentor-applicant chat and notification records.

The system shall support administrator review workflows for identity and enterprise certification, including automatic field validation, manual approval or rejection, state tracking, feedback, resubmission, and deletion of violating posts and comments.
The system shall enforce access permissions, encrypt login, registration, and chat data, restrict abnormal login and operation behavior, and provide risk-control logs and behavior audits.
